ReSpliceCharmweavers.ThrallWorkModeDef.label: work
ReSpliceCharmweavers.ThrallWorkModeDef.description: Thralls work autonomously according to their job assignments and attend to their needs as necessary.

ReSpliceCharmweavers.ThrallWorkModeDef.label: escort
ReSpliceCharmweavers.ThrallWorkModeDef.description: Thralls stay near their master and fight nearby enemies. They follow their master even off the map.

ReSpliceCharmweavers.ThrallWorkModeDef.label: worship
ReSpliceCharmweavers.ThrallWorkModeDef.description: Thralls stay near their master and entertain them socially to keep their mood up. They do not follow their master off the map.
